title: Excise Tariff Amendment (Product Stewardship for Oil) Bill 2014
short_title: Excise Tariff Amendment (Product Stewardship for Oil) Bill 2014

speeches.speaker: Andrew Leigh
speeches.brief: Moved an amendment condemning the government for eroding market-based environmental incentives, noting the carbon price had cut electricity sector emissions by 7.6 per cent in its first year, and cited modelling suggesting the government's Direct Action Emissions Reduction Fund would need to spend $40 billion by 2020 just to meet a five per cent reduction target.

speeches.speaker: Ken O'Dowd
speeches.brief: Supported the Product Stewardship for Oil bills, saying the scheme is running a $10 million deficit, and highlighted the new $55 million Southern Oil re-refining plant in Gladstone, which processes about 30 per cent of Australia's waste lube oil and employs 45 people.

speeches.speaker: Michael McCormack
speeches.brief: Detailed the Northern Oil Refinery in Gladstone, which can process 100 million litres of oil a year, the same as Queensland's entire annual waste oil production, and said it injects an estimated $15 million into the regional economy each year while employing 40 people directly.

speeches.speaker: Greg Hunt
speeches.brief: Defended the Product Stewardship for Oil bills, saying annual used oil collection has risen from about 160 million to 270 million litres since the scheme began, supporting an oil recycling industry with a combined turnover of at least $3 billion.

speeches.speaker: Steven Ciobo
speeches.brief: Summed up the Product Stewardship for Oil bills, confirming the levy would rise to fix the scheme's roughly $10 million deficit, and rejected Labor's amendment defending the carbon tax, said to cost households an extra $550 a year.

acts.title: Excise Tariff Amendment (Product Stewardship for Oil) Act 2014
